title: Root Froot
body:
Description


''Can be eaten for a short levitation effect.''

Root Froot is a consumable in Oaklands. It is primarily gathered to create preserves or used directly for its unique mobility effects.

Spawning & Location

Found underground within the Lumite and River Cave networks.

  • Grows exclusively on the branches of Root Trees.
  • A single Root Tree spawns between 1 and 10 individual Root Froots.
  • Regrows over time along with tree node resets.

Economics & Processing

  • $180 when sold raw.
  • $720 when processed in a Canning Station.
  • Processing Root Froot into jams offers one of the highest profit multipliers. (4x raw value)

Player Effects & Gameplay Use

  • Raw Consumption Grants a short Levitation effect when the player jumps, lasting roughly 7 to 10 seconds.
  • Jarred Consumption Grants an extended Air Swimming effect, allowing vertical and horizontal directional movement through the air for approximately 40 seconds.

Notes(cons&pros)

  • It is not worth to grind it for money.
  • It's difficult to acquire at first, but once you get it, it's easy.
  • Levitation is good for collecting Celestial Blossom.
  • Jam version is an early-stage plane/helicopter for flying but its slow.
